newsitem.title: USA: Biomune names Ira Ritter president.
newsitem.headline: Biomune names Ira Ritter president.

text.p: Biomune Systems Inc said on Thursday it named Ira Ritter its president.
Ritter replaces interim President David Derrick, who remains as chairman and chief executive, the company said in a news release.
Ritter most recently was vice chairman of a national food and cosmetic distributor, which the company did not name.
Biomune also said it acquired the right to buy Ritter's controlling interest in Rockwood Inc, which distributes products to health food stores nationwide.
Biomune develops biologic pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products through its wholly owned subsidiary, Optim Nutrition.
